terminus.finding: The bureaucracy test does not break the substitution model, but changes its shape. In the migrant-trafficking thesis, statutory coordination structures and regular coordination meetings do not guarantee practical coordination; actual inter-agency agreements rely heavily on informal contact channels, while staff face resource scarcity and crowding-out from routine duties. The care/community case likewise presents service as a platform joining volunteers, health checks, meals, learning, spatial reuse and neighborhood relationships rather than a single standardized task.
terminus.candidate: Refine 'institutional habitat' into two layers: formal apparatus and operative relational infrastructure. A formal tool may exist while the function survives elsewhere through informal contacts, situated judgment and relationship work. Automation/substitution analysis should therefore ask not only what task remains, but where the operative function migrates when formal structure is weak or overloaded.
terminus.next: seek a case where formalization itself successfully absorbs relational work without loss; this would be a stronger disconfirmation test
